name: Atlassian
description: Import Confluence pages as documents and let the agent work with Jira issues.

authMode.label: Auth method
authMode.description: How Hay.chat signs in to Atlassian.

siteUrl.label: Atlassian site URL
siteUrl.description: Used for both Confluence and Jira.

apiToken.label: API token
apiToken.description: Works for both Confluence and Jira. Create one at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Set up for you by Hay.chat. Change it only if you run your own Hay.chat server with your own app.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Set up for you by Hay.chat. Change it only if you run your own Hay.chat server with your own app.
